description: List the token owner's OpenTrain jobs with status, publish state, proposal counts, and live URLs. Requires jobs:read scope. Use this to find job ids for opentrain_list_proposals or opentrain_publish_job.

limit.description: Maximum jobs to return. Defaults to 25.

status.description: Optional job status filter: DRAFT, OPEN, ONGOING, COMPLETED, ARCHIVED, or PENDING_APPROVAL. Omit to list all non-deleted jobs.

name: opentrain_list_jobs
